questions.evidence:
RESERVATION LIST: Ten tables seat four people each. Eight families have confirmed one table each. Their group sizes are four, four, three, three, two, two, four, and three. Two more families are on the waiting list, each hoping for a table.

DESK UPDATE: One confirmed family of three cancels before Thursday noon. Staff offer that table to the first waiting family, which has four people and accepts. The second waiting family has two people and has not yet received an offer.

ROOM RULE: Empty seats at a confirmed family's table are not automatically separate bookable places. Staff may combine families only with their agreement. The event may still offer tables that have never been reserved, so the desk must track tables separately from people.

The organizer asks an assistant to count confirmed tables, confirmed visitors, and unreserved tables after the accepted replacement. The assistant first calls every empty seat available, then corrects the report. A room's physical capacity does not by itself describe the current reservation status.
